title: [NSW, VIC, QLD] Free Complimentary Valet Pass for Westfield Members @ Select Westfield Shopping Centres
body:
Deal: [NSW, VIC, QLD] Free Complimentary Valet Pass for Westfield Members @ Select Westfield Shopping Centres

[tenpercent] Participating centres: Bondi, Carindale, Chermside, Doncaster, Miranda.
No Westfield Mt Druitt?
[Wiadro] dont want your car broken into or stolen do you?
[Stefce] I don't trust my wife with the car, you expect me to trust a valet?
[FutureTech] the good thing is if a valet trashes your car they pay to get it fixed.
[IlIlIl IlI llIIIl] Probably not. I'm sure there's some waiver
[87percent] Look at mr fancy pants getting driven around
[Onemoredeal] Seinfeld destroyed any chance of a valet getting in my car
[tenpercent] Unless the valet is named Jeeves , I'm not interested.
[johnthedoe] Bondi might actually be worth it that parking lot is atrocious.
[Mjk698] The way idiots park in general I would never trust a valet. I literally watched a woman deliberately park squarely over 4 individual car parks like I expected the nutty professor to get out the car but nope she was tiny and didn't even care…
See it all the time parking without even caring if they left room to get in and out safely or if they aren't parked over the lines hindering others.
[askbargain] Same thing with general hygiene but you still trust chefs.
[nokidsandthreemoney] Wtf do these valets even do?! I get that they park your car but it seems like more steps than just doing it yourself if you've got to request for the car to be brought back etc. Plus the old grandma on the pic who is in valet clothes looks like the same woman I roll my eyes at and eventually scream lungs out at inside my car when trying to leave the shops because they drive like a snail and can't figure out how to insert their card to get the boom gate open.
